title: Baby Leo and Friends Learn About Animals
summary: Today, Baby Leo, Bella, Bobo, Marjona, and Twinkle explore the animal world! Bella has a fun idea to teach everyone about different animals and their sounds. Together, they learn to recognize animals and the importance of taking care of them.
lesson: Kids learn about different animals and their sounds.
beats: Baby Leo, Bella, Bobo, and Marjona gather in the sunny garden. Baby Leo asks, 'What animals do we know?' Bella suggests they learn about animals today. They all cheer and decide to go on an animal adventure!
Twinkle flies in sparkling brightly. She says, 'Let’s visit the animal park!' The friends leap with joy. They all jump into Twinkle's sparkle light to travel together.
At the animal park, they see a big brown bear. Bobo giggles and says, 'Bear! Bear!' They all make bear sounds together, 'Roar!' Bella smiles and suggests they learn more.
Next, they see a fluffy white bunny. Bella hops around and says, 'Bunny, Bunny!' They all hop like bunnies and make soft bunny sounds, 'Hop, hop!' Everyone laughs and joins in.
Suddenly, they hear a loud 'Quack!' from the pond. Marjona says, 'Look! It’s a duck!' They all quack like ducks together. Baby Leo claps his hands, 'Quack, quack!'
While exploring, they come across a sleeping puppy. Bella suggests they be quiet. They tiptoe around and whisper, 'Puppy! Shh!' Bobo gives the puppy a gentle hug.
Next, they hear a lion's roar from a distance. Baby Leo says, 'Let’s pretend to be lions!' They all roar together and imagine being brave lions.
After a fun day, they gather to share what they learned. Bella says, 'Animals have different sounds!' Marjona adds, 'And they need our care and kindness!'
They decide to help animals in their neighborhood, just like they learned today. They cheer, 'Let’s help our animal friends!'
Baby Leo and friends smile, happy to have learned about animals and how to care for them. They leave the park, singing songs about their favorite animals!
